text:
maya: quick thread - big customer insists on CompetitorX-style per-tenant routing and A/B fallback. sales pushing for go-live in ~6w. thoughts: fast parity surface vs. building a durable control plane?
jordan: clarify parity: do they need the UI or just the API hooks + docs?
samir: they explicitly called UI toggle + ability to assign weights per-tenant. timeline is non-negotiable for them.
elaine: 6w doable if we scope a "parity shim" only: thin adaptor + minimal console (toggle + rule list) + canary. no RBAC/schedules/smart composer.
maya: risks: shim creates duplicate config paths and a migration burden. need explicit deprecation plan.
ravi: ops/infra POV: also need metrics and an emergency rollback path. propose: dashboard widget + alert if fallback > 5% for 10m, and a global kill-switch endpoint.
jordan: product acceptance proposal: 1) API accepts per-tenant rules (weights/priorities), 2) minimal console toggle and list, 3) canary rollout flag, 4) telemetry for fallback/route-util, 5) documented migration path and 30d deprecation window.
samir: sales messaging: we'll offer pilot parity shim with guaranteed migration timeline to the canonical controls in H2. include acceptance test cases they can run.
elaine: dev plan (high level): week A: adaptor + API + basic smoke tests; week B: UI + canary; week C: telemetry + alerts; week D: customer onboarding + hardening. parallelize FE/BE where possible. need one extra FE for B+C.
maya: (typo) - maya: allocate resource?
maya: @eng-leads can we get the FE contractor for 3 sprints? otherwise we offer API-only pilot.
jordan: do we mark this in roadmap as "temporary parity pilot"? calling it "feature" could mislead others. I prefer explicit "pilot: parity shim" with follow-up epic for canonical routing.
samir: i'll draft the acceptance checklist and test scripts. include an automated smoke that posts rules and validates no fallback on green.
elaine: sample curl for QA:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.test/v1/tenants/test-tenant/routes \
 -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
 -d '{"rules":[{"variant":"v2","weight":70},{"variant":"v1","weight":30}]}'
```
alex: (joining) add: require a canary flag and kill-switch in prod to flip traffic back to global routing in <1s. also add a tech-debt ticket linking shim->canonical migration steps.
maya: decision for today: greenlight parity shim pilot contingent on FE contractor approval + ops playbook + sales acceptance doc. product will own 30d deprecation notice and roadmap entry.
note: action items - samir to draft sales acceptance doc (EOD), elaine to open PRD and tech-debt ticket, maya to follow up on FE resource.
deploy-bot: feature/parity-shim scheduled to deploy to staging at 2026-05-06T14:00Z.
jordan: reconvene Fri to confirm resourcing and finalize customer-facing language.
